ns2:course.label: Food Sci Professional Issues
ns2:course.description: Discussion of current topics in food science and professional issues, including ethics, undergraduate research, study abroad, graduate school options and internships. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Sophomore and Junior transfer students with a Food Science concentration only.
